raw_segments.text: His voice lost itself in the calm of the evening.
The long shadows of the forest had slipped downhill while we talked, had gone far beyond
the ruined hovel, beyond the symbolic row of stakes.
All this was in the gloom, while we down there were yet in the sunshine, and the stretch
of the river abreast of the clearing glittered in a still and dazzling splendor, with a murky
and overshadowed bend above and below.
Not a living soul was seen on the shore.
